【原视频简介】
MythBusters — S11 E10 "Breaking Bad Special" — Aired August 12, 2013

Breaking Bad creator Vince Gilligan and star Aaron Paul joined the full MythBusters team to find out whether the two most iconic chemistry moments in the show's history could actually work in real life — first testing whether concentrated hydrofluoric acid poured into a bathtub could dissolve a human body, eat through the tub, and destroy the floor beneath it, starting with small samples at a UC Berkeley lab before finding that hydrofluoric acid wasn't nearly corrosive enough in practice to match what the show depicted, and switching to concentrated sulfuric acid with a secret chemical booster, eventually using 36 gallons in a fiberglass tub at Vince and Aaron's suggestion before delivering a verdict that surprised even the guests who wrote the scenes, and then finding out whether the solid chunk of mercury fulminate Walt throws in the finale could actually detonate, kill bystanders, and shatter windows, with Vince Gilligan on set insisting the whole time that he had done his research.

Using science as their weapon and curiosity as their fuel, Hollywood special effects experts Adam Savage and Jamie Hyneman spent 14 seasons and 296 episodes testing the world's most popular myths, urban legends, and movie moments.
